note.title: Book and intake brief
note.markdown:
# Book and intake brief: as of 22 Nov

## Loss ratio
**Commercial Auto is deteriorating.** Its loss ratio was 87.5% on losses from April to September, against 55.4% in 2025. The line has 86 open claims carrying $2.95M of case reserves, and 20 of them have been open for more than six months. Recent accident months are immature, so this ratio is more likely to rise than fall as claims develop.

Workers Compensation rose to 60.5% from 46.4%. Commercial Property was flat at 66.2% (66.3% in 2025), and General Liability improved to 51.3% from 63.4%.

## Producer retention
Delmar Insurance Brokers renewed 64.2% of its 134 policies expiring since July, against 83.9% before July and 81.4% for the other producers over the same period.

## Submission intake
The extraction workflow read 10 broker submissions. 129 of 130 fields (99.2%) matched the source document, with **no silent errors**: the one wrong value was flagged for review. Five submissions went straight through, and five are in the review queue with 9 flagged fields:
- **Saltmarsh Seafood Processing (SUB-2704):** the effective date can be read two ways. The extracted reading is wrong and is correctly held for review.
- **Orchard Hill Senior Living (SUB-2708):** no loss history; the broker says loss runs will follow.
- **Halloway Freight Lines (SUB-2703):** revenue was given only in words (extracted as $4.2M), and the date can be read two ways.
- **Kestrel Landscaping Group (SUB-2709)** and **Mercer Street Hotels LLC (SUB-2710):** dates that could be read two ways.

Cobbler Lane Bakery Co (SUB-2706) went through with a note: a broker note updated its headcount to 85.

## For discussion
- A Commercial Auto review: rate adequacy, the open-claim reserves, and whether to tighten appetite for the line.
- A retention conversation with Delmar Insurance Brokers.
- Recording each broker's date convention so that unambiguous dates stop being flagged; most date flags this week were correct under the US reading.
